# CloudFormation resource types

The resource registry contains **90 types**. Each type supports only its registered properties and attributes. The linked source defines that subset; an SDK operation existing does not imply CloudFormation support.

See [infrastructure workflows](infrastructure.md) for SAM and Terraform.
